info.title: Mizaic Ingestion API
info.description:
HTTP/s Endpoint Server for Mizaic Ingest Engine

**Environment configuration:** **Patient identifier validation is enabled.** Requests must include valid patient identifiers.

Full openapi json specification available [here](/system/swagger.json)

post.description:
Dry-run validation before deleting batches.

**Checks**
- Batch IDs exist and are eligible for deletion
- No cross-batch page donations block the delete
- Returns per-batch counts (blobs, bundles, pages, images)

**Next step** — use the returned `confirmToken` with `POST /admin/batches/delete`.

**Auth** — `x-api-key` header must match a value in `ADMIN_API_KEYS`.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Admin API key

post.description:
Starts an asynchronous delete job after validating the preview `confirmToken`.

Poll progress with `GET /admin/batches/delete/status?id={jobId}`.

**Auth** — `x-api-key` header must match a value in `ADMIN_API_KEYS`.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Admin API key

202.description: Job accepted — poll status with returned `jobId`

409.description: Another delete job is already in progress

422.description: Invalid confirmToken or batch state changed since preview

get.description:
Returns job progress and per-batch results.

**Auth** — `x-api-key` header must match a value in `ADMIN_API_KEYS`.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Admin API key

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job ID from `POST /admin/batches/delete`

get.summary: List all Bull queues and job counts by status
get.description:
Returns one entry per Redis-discovered Bull queue with `name` and `counts` from Bull `getJobCounts()`
(e.g. waiting, active, completed, delayed, failed, paused). No per-job payloads.
Requires `x-api-key` matching an entry in `ADMIN_API_KEYS`.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Admin API key from ADMIN_API_KEYS

post.summary: Pause or resume one or all Bull queues
post.description:
Calls Bull `pause()` or `resume()` like the Admin UI queues page.
Requires `x-api-key` matching an entry in `ADMIN_API_KEYS`.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Admin API key from ADMIN_API_KEYS

parameters.name: queue
parameters.description: Bull queue name (use this or `all=true`, not both)

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: If true, applies the action to all discovered queues

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Defaults to pause

400.description: Invalid parameters (missing target, conflicting params, invalid action)

get.summary: Retrieve configuration for a specific endpoint
get.description:
Returns the configuration for the given `{path}` if it exists and is enabled.
Each endpoint has its own API key — include it in the `x-api-key` header.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The endpoint path configured by Mizaic and provided to you.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Per-endpoint API key

401.description: API key missing, expired or invalid for this endpoint

post.summary: Upload a file to a configured endpoint
post.description:
Accepts multipart/form-data with a file and optional metadata fields defined in
the endpoint's schema. Each endpoint has its own API key that must be provided
in the `x-api-key` header.
If patient validation is enabled by Mizaic, the patient identifier and type must
correspond to an existing record in the database.
A `200 OK` response indicates the file has been accepted for processing,
**not** that it has finished importing.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The endpoint path configured by Mizaic and provided to you.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Per-endpoint API key

identifier.description:
Optional patient identifier if validation is enabled.

**This field must match an existing patient record.**

identifierType.description:
Type of patient identifier.

**This field must match an existing patient record.**

400.description: Invalid patient identifier or schema error

401.description: API key missing or invalid for this endpoint

get.description:
Returns the current status and details of a job upload by its ID and endpoint path.
Each endpoint has its own API key that must be provided in the `x-api-key` header.
Data may be limited to last 90 days depending on the Mizaic import job retention policy.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The endpoint path configured by Mizaic

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Database ObjectID of the import job

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: Per-endpoint API key

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when job was last updated

documentInformation.description: Document details (only present when status is "Finalized")

400.description: Path or Batch ID missing from request

error.example: Path and Batch ID are required

401.description: API key missing or invalid for this endpoint

examples: Handler not found for the specified path
Batch information not found for the specified ID, possibly past retention period

get.summary: Retrieve patient encounters to obtain a stay number for importing documents related to a specific encounter
get.description:
Returns a list of encounters (visits/admissions) for a specific patient.
Results can be filtered by date range, specialty, and event type.
Each endpoint has its own API key that must be provided in the `x-api-key` header.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key provided to you by Mizaic upon enablement of this API

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Patient identifier (Hospital Number or NHS Number)

parameters.name: identifierType
parameters.description: Type of patient identifier (HN = Hospital Number, NN = NHS Number)

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Optional start date to filter encounters (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Optional end date to filter encounters (ISO 8601 format)

parameters.name: specialty
parameters.description: Optional specialty filter

parameters.name: eventType
parameters.description: Optional event type filter, where AE = Accident & Emergency, IP = Inpatient, OP = Outpatient

eventType.description: Type of event/encounter. Must be one of "AE", "IP", "OP"

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when record was last updated

get.description:
Returns basic patient demographic information by Hospital Number (HN) or NHS Number (NN).
Requires a valid API key in the `x-api-key` header.

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: API key for patient information access

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Patient identifier (Hospital Number or NHS Number)

parameters.name: identifierType
parameters.description: Type of patient identifier (HN = Hospital Number, NN = NHS Number)

DOD.description: Date of death (null if patient is alive)

schema.example: Patient Information API is not configured.
